title: Lion cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glowing floor shadows -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='13' ry='3' fill='#ffcc66' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='90' rx='13' ry='3' fill='#ffcc66' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 72 Q88 70 86 56' stroke='#e8a33d' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='54' r='5' fill='#c45a2a'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#e8823d'/>

  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M60 78 Q64 88 59 91' stroke='#d98a2b' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='92' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b04a'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='66' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#f5b84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#ffd98a'/>

  <!-- front leg raised -->
  <path d='M42 68 Q34 60 28 54' stroke='#e89a32' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='52' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0b04a' transform='rotate(-30 27 52)'/>
  <!-- paw pads on raised paw -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#c46a22'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#c46a22'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#c46a22'/>

  <!-- front leg down -->
  <path d='M58 76 Q60 86 56 90' stroke='#d98a2b' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b04a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='40' r='19' fill='#f5b84a'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='40' r='23' fill='#e0802a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='24' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='21' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='33' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='47' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='47' r='7' fill='#e0802a'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='47' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffe1a8'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='38' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='36.5' r='1.3' fill='#fff6dd'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36.5' r='1.3' fill='#fff6dd'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M49 45 Q52 43 55 45 Q52 48 49 45 Z' fill='#c45a2a'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M52 48 Q48 52 46 51 M52 48 Q56 52 58 51' stroke='#a8481f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff9a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff9a6a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='26' r='6' fill='#f5b84a'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='26' r='3' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='6' fill='#f5b84a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='3' fill='#ffd98a'/>

  <!-- dance motion sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#fff1a8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#fff1a8'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='65' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <path d='M30 30 L32 34 L36 34 L33 37 L34 41 L30 38 L26 41 L27 37 L24 34 L28 34 Z' fill='#fff1a8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
